question: Does the Tianyi Pavilion Qing manuscript of 《鐵琴銅劍樓藏書目錄》 directly attest 孫逢古 for the Zhunzhai entry and explicitly connect that copy description to the Huang-family/Raoweng transmission route?
answer: YES AT THE QING BIBLIOGRAPHIC-MANUSCRIPT LAYER. SOURCE-BOUND 300DPI REVIEW OF PDF P387 DIRECTLY READS 準齋心製几漏圖式一卷 / 影鈔本 / 宋孫逢古撰并序 AND SUMMARIZES 逢古創為小壺分二十五箭...曾著錄文淵閣書目...與銅壺漏箭制度合裝. PDF P388 CONTINUES 一冊 / 郡中黃氏舊藏 / 蕘翁有跋. THIS CONFIRMS THAT 孫逢古 ENTERED A QING BIBLIOGRAPHIC TRANSMISSION TRADITION AND THAT THE TIEQIN DESCRIPTION EXPLICITLY POINTS TO THE HUANG/RAOWENG ROUTE. IT DOES NOT DATE THE MANUSCRIPT EXACTLY, DOES NOT PROVE THE 1823 NLC MANUSCRIPT IS THE SAME PHYSICAL SOURCE, DOES NOT OVERRIDE THE EARLIER 1602/1605 孫逢吉 WITNESSES, AND DOES NOT CLOSE YUAN PERSON IDENTITY, PRE-1578 RULE PROSE, OR SANMING PARENTAGE.
